description: With T maximal, a longer constituent forbids the omission whether or not the written optional can complete. On B D T, y → B D is longer than y → B, so leaving out [T A] after y → B is forbidden, although [T A] cannot complete. begins of r is false (engine §4).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%elidable maximal T
%rule text B D T
%conditions begins(from($), r)
%rule r y [T A] D
%rule y B | B D
